title: Epic: Input injection and command safety
description: Address gosec findings related to untrusted input reaching sensitive sinks: G705 (XSS via taint) and G204 (subprocess with variable). CWE-78.

title: Epic: File path traversal prevention
description: Address gosec G304 finding: potential file inclusion via variable. CWE-22.

title: Epic: Unhandled error returns
description: Address gosec G104 findings: unhandled error returns from Flush() calls. CWE-703.

title: G705: Sanitize error output to stderr in main.go:70
description: gosec G705 (MEDIUM/HIGH): XSS via taint analysis. fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err.Error()) passes potentially tainted error message to output. While stderr is not a web context, sanitize or constrain the error message to prevent taint propagation. File: main.go:70

title: G204: Validate or restrict subprocess command in cmd_unix.go:16
description: gosec G204 (MEDIUM/HIGH, CWE-78): Subprocess launched with variable. exec.Command(cmd, args...) uses caller-supplied cmd string directly. Consider validating cmd against an allowlist or documenting the trust boundary. File: cmd_unix.go:16

title: G304: Sanitize file path in os.Open call in main.go:131
description: gosec G304 (MEDIUM/HIGH, CWE-22): Potential file inclusion via variable. os.Open(argFile) uses user-supplied path without sanitization. Validate with filepath.Clean(), check for path traversal (../), and optionally restrict to a base directory. File: main.go:131

title: G104: Handle error from w.out.Flush() in worker_pool.go:83
description: gosec G104 (LOW/HIGH, CWE-703): Return value of w.out.Flush() not checked. Flush can fail on I/O errors. Capture and log or propagate the error. File: worker_pool.go:83

title: G104: Handle error from w.err.Flush() in worker_pool.go:84
description: gosec G104 (LOW/HIGH, CWE-703): Return value of w.err.Flush() not checked. Flush can fail on I/O errors. Capture and log or propagate the error. File: worker_pool.go:84
